name: Identity
overview: Scripture reveals that human identity is rooted in being created in God's image, affirming inherent worth and purpose (Genesis 1:27). God intimately knows and ordains each person even before birth, demonstrating His sovereign design and care (Jeremiah 1:5). Through faith in Christ, believers are granted the privilege to become children of God and are called friends of Jesus, reflecting a transformed relationship with God (John 1:12; John 15:15). This new identity is marked by a life lived in union with Christ, empowered by His love and sacrifice (Galatians 2:20).
